providerSubstitution.seam: A Node ESM loader resolves only Gigi's imports of webgpu to the selected provider module; generated workloads, shaders, assets, and validation logic are unchanged.

runtimeOwnershipPlan.incumbentLimitation: The generated application depends on incumbent WGSL lowering, descriptor binding, synchronization, and readback behavior whose correction cadence is controlled by the incumbent distribution.
runtimeOwnershipPlan.applicationConsequence: A provider defect can reject, crash, or misexecute an unchanged generated WebGPU case until an incumbent release or bounded patch is available.

materialOutcome.metric: unchanged generated-case oracle coverage, crash and timeout freedom, semantic replay, and first-failure classification across the complete pinned suite
materialOutcome.decisionRule: Promote DoeRuntime only if D0 passes a release-relevant case or reliability boundary that W0 cannot match; require P0 only when W0 exposes such a defect, and reject runtime ownership when W0 and D0 have the same governed outcome.

I0.construction: The unchanged generated application resolves its ambient upstream-installed webgpu package without Doe's provider loader or receipt interpretation.

I1.construction: The exact webgpu@0.4.0 package installed for the pinned checkout is selected explicitly through the provider seam without DoeProof replay.

W0.construction: I1 under the hash-bound suite, oracle, provider identity, diagnostics, receipt, and semantic replay contract.

D0.construction: DoeRuntime under the same hash-bound suite, oracle, provider identity, diagnostics, receipt, and semantic replay contract.

P0.construction: W0 plus the smallest reviewable incumbent correction, required only if W0 exposes a release-relevant defect that D0 passes.

fallbackPolicy.providerIdentityAssertion: A provider probe records the exact selected module and adapter identity before any case; software adapters make the run diagnostic and promotion-ineligible.

workload.sameWorkPolicy: Both providers execute every selected generated index.js from the pinned suite in a clean Node process, from the original case directory, against the same generated modules, assets, shaders, and upstream validation logic.
workload.completionBoundary: A case ends only when its Node process exits after queue completion, readback, and upstream validation, or when the governed timeout terminates it.

performancePolicy.timingScope: clean Node process start through upstream validation and process exit
